products_page.chem_intro: Chemical resistance is influenced by various factors such as concentration, temperature and duration of exposure. The following information should therefore be understood as recommendations.

sort_thicknesses.applications: Fine and sticky materials where anti-adhesion properties are beneficial. Noise protection linings, impact protection for powdery materials (lime, cement, liquid concrete).
Fine rock (sand, gravel, concrete), wear protection linings (0–32 mm). Noise reduction applications. Universal and cost-effective wear protection.
Highly versatile. Rock (0–65 mm), recycling applications (glass, metal, plastics). Mechanical engineering, chute and slide linings, tipper bodies.
High stress applications (0–100 mm). Feed hoppers, recycling applications (concrete, metal, glass). Where safety and longevity are required.
Very high stress. Heavy-duty applications, industry, mining, high material flows and continuous operation (24/7).
